summary: Retested the checkout post-submit navigation hotfix (placed useRef guard) and full GCash happy path end-to-end via UI. All three requested flows PASS: (1) GCash checkout auto-navigates to /gcash-pay/{orderId} with all expected data-testids visible (gcash-pay-page, gcash-name, gcash-number, gcash-qr-img, gcash-ref-input, gcash-submit-btn); (2) COD checkout auto-navigates to /orders and shows success toast 'Order placed! Pay on delivery.'; (3) Neither flow lands on /market anymore. GCash reference submission (REF12345TEST) succeeded with 'Reference submitted!' toast and redirect to /orders. Seller (Mang Kanor) verify-payment-<orderId> button confirmed the payment - 'Payment confirmed' toast displayed and the seller dashboard now shows order #115cd711 as 'GCash (paid)'. The previously reported HIGH bug from iteration_4 is fixed.

issues: Collapsed order rows only show the fulfillment 'Pending' badge; the payment sub-state (e.g. gcash_submitted / awaiting seller confirmation) is only visible after expanding. A small inline chip on the collapsed row would make status clearer for GCash orders.

critical_code_review_comments: Checkout.jsx line 28 combines three concerns in one useEffect on a single line - readable but consider splitting auth-guard vs empty-cart-guard for maintainability.

placed.current is never reset on submit failure; if the /api/checkout call succeeds server-side but the client throws before navigate (very unlikely), the user could be stuck. Current implementation only sets placed.current = true AFTER a successful response, so this is safe.
COD/GCash both call clear() before navigate(); the placed guard correctly prevents the empty-cart redirect from firing before navigate resolves. Verified in browser.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 5 confirmed the useRef 'placed' guard fixes the post-checkout /market redirect bug for both COD and GCash. Full GCash lifecycle (buyer places -> submits ref -> seller confirms -> paid) works end-to-end via the deployed UI. Backend was not retested this iteration (already verified in prior iterations, no backend changes).
rca of the issue: Prior bug (iteration_4): the empty-cart redirect useEffect in Checkout.jsx re-ran after clear() emptied the cart post-successful checkout, racing with the intended navigate() call and sending the user to /market. Fix: introduced `const placed = useRef(false)`; set to true immediately after successful /api/checkout response and short-circuit the guard useEffect via `if (loading || placed.current) return;`. Verified across GCash and COD.
